quotes.where: Results, 'Functional analysis of gene architecture and conservation'
quotes.text: Variants with an FDR ≥0.01 were categorized as ‘unchanged’, those with an FDR <0.01 and a negative functional score were categorized as ‘depleted’ and those with an FDR <0.01 and a positive functional score were categorized as ‘enriched’. Data for 18,108 unique variants were collected after filtering steps with variants categorized as follows: 11,912 unchanged, 5,665 depleted and 531 enriched (Supplementary Table 2).

quotes.where: Methods, 'Calculation of variant abundance and functional scores'
quotes.text: Variants with an FDR <0.01 and a negative functional score were classified as ‘depleted’ and those with an FDR <0.01 and a positive functional score were classified as ‘enriched’. Variants with an FDR ≥0.01 were classified as ‘unchanged’.

quotes.where: Methods, 'Calculation of variant abundance and functional scores'
quotes.text: To avoid confusion, all ‘functional classifications’ were made using the ‘functional score’ and its corresponding FDR.

quotes.where: Results, 'BAP1 essentiality permits mutational consequence separation'
quotes.text: By combining library A and library B, we calculated a single ‘functional score’ for each variant (Methods). This is the apparent growth rate across D4, D7, D10, D14 and D21 computed by log-linear regression in DESeq2 (ref. <sup>14</sup>) and represents log<sub>2</sub>-transformed fold change (LFC) per unit time (Methods).

quotes.where: Results, 'Assessment of BAP1 variants in cancer and neurodevelopment'
quotes.text: To this end, we ranked the 5,665 depleted variants (we excluded enriched variants) by categorizing them on either side of the median, defining them as strongly depleted (n = 2,833) or weakly depleted (n = 2,832) (Fig. 4e).
Depleted variants (n = 5,665) categorized into strongly depleted (lower 50%, dark blue) and weakly depleted (upper 50%, light blue) variants, either side of the median functional score (−0.1260642).

rules.name: Results and Methods: FDR and sign, depleted split at the printed median
rules.inputs_note: the functional score (log-linear regression across D4-D21) is the score table's 'score' column, equal on every row to processed_LFC_continuous; its corresponding FDR is processed_BH_FDR_continuous. The paper does not say on which side of the median a variant scoring exactly the printed median falls; such a variant is depleted, without a side

classes.class: depleted (on the printed median; side not stated)

default.class: unassigned (FDR<0.01 and a score of exactly 0)

transcription_note: Quotes copied verbatim from the paper's full text (PMC JATS XML) on 2026-10-21; <i>, <sub> and <sup> reproduce the source's inline markup; scripts/stage_E16c/check_paper_quotes.py checks every quote against the document as served. The rules below are the quoted sentences typed into machine form by hand; a test checks that every number they use appears in a quote. Canonical classes follow the functionalClassification the archive's investigator calibration gives the same class name.
